anchors: send `vnc-remote-control --port <local-port> key space` once a second
decision: Drive a VMware Workstation VM through its own .vmx-enabled VNC server over an SSH tunnel, and press space once a second after vmrun start to pass the EFI ISO boot prompt.

evidence.text: Facts from the queued incident report (not reproducible here); `key space` checked against the CLI's key table. RED (opus) on the pre-edit text: NONE; GREEN (opus, haiku) answered from the new section.

reopen_if: VMware Workstation drops its built-in VNC server or the boot prompt changes.
why: A headless Windows guest booting from an EFI ISO stops at 'Press any key to boot from CD or DVD' and falls through if nothing is pressed; the server listens on every interface, so it must not be exposed.
